correctness.rationale: One-cycle reflection-principle inverse-local-time identity gives a point-mass/exponential mixture for complete-cycle contact reward with finite moment generating function. Union bounds with Poisson deviations and iid Cramér bounds prove exponential concentration of retained local time around Jt without assuming length-reward independence. Regular variation transfers this to exact reaction survival asymptotics. A fresh threshold each reset gives exact renewal Laplace transform; its denominator remains positive in a neighborhood of zero, proving an exponential moment. Complete domain, normalizations, quantifiers and special alpha=1 Lomax qualification checked; CHECK.py confirms independent integral/algebra constants but is not proof.

evidence: Bressloff 2022a §4 treats Pareto stopping laws in fully renewed protocols; its Eq. 4.32 is a mean formula, not a retained asymptotic.
Bressloff 2022b Eq. 3.17 is linear in the fixed threshold for retained local time, which implies the mean criterion but not directly the full tail equivalence.
The inverse boundary-local-time transform, linear contact-production rate and its optimizer are prior mathematical facts and are explicitly excluded from claimed novelty.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Published and owned work implies the exact cycle reward transform, the mean relation, and the simple optimizer. The new claim requires the exponential concentration of cumulative contact time and transfer of arbitrary slowly varying tails, with a protocol distinction requiring independent resampling. None of the inspected statements, as presented, asserts or algebraically immediately identifies the full regularly varying survival profile.

evidence: Bressloff 2022a §3: general contact propagator for position resets, not a retained random-threshold asymptotic.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Equivalent formulations as an inverse-local-time subordinator, renewal reward, and contact-state conservation were compared. The inverse exponent and linear throughput alone are already known; they do not literally state a sharp asymptotic with regularly varying arbitrary thresholds unless combined with concentration. The present claim explicitly includes that nontrivial transfer and competing fresh-redraw protocol.

evidence: The checked primary texts give numerical examples and general formulas, but no table of retained contact-time survival coefficients for regularly varying thresholds.
The claim is an all-rate asymptotic theorem, not a finite exact-data census.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: The cited primary sources were inspected for any numerical or analytical table giving the stated asymptotic constant. None of the inspected tables does so; this does not rule out other literature.

originality.rationale: The exact boundary-contact reward law and source equations are known background. Published 2022 full texts treat incomplete resetting implicitly for arbitrary thresholds and give deterministic-threshold mean, or explicit Pareto calculations only for full renewal. The final new proposition is the sharp asymptotic P(T_keep>t)~Psi(Jt) for random regularly varying retained thresholds, with the consequent strict exponential-tail contrast when a fresh threshold is independently resampled. No inspected source or recoverable same-topic historical claim states this proposition. General renewal-reward/regular-variation machinery may implicitly entail it; a priority risk remains.
residual_risks: Sharp survival equivalence may be implicit in general light-tailed renewal-reward sampling and regular-variation literature even if not explicitly presented for this reflected-Brownian reaction model.
No independent full-literature priority audit was performed; especially same-model recent papers or non-arXiv sources may imply the result.
Comparison with Bodrova–Sokolov 2020 is abstract-only, although its observable is different.

value.rationale: A non-exponential surface reaction with random contact budget is physically motivated in the Bressloff encounter model. The quantitative result determines the entire long-time reaction-time universality class and exact amplitude for the genuinely nonrenewal retained-contact process, and shows a qualitative algebraic-to-exponential survival change induced by independent threshold refreshing. The infinite-mean regime persists despite every positive position-reset rate, which matters for reaction and transport interpretation. This is not a renaming of the known inverse-subordinator or deterministic threshold mean.
